note: One table for both halves of the guardian: the plugin (Python) finds a risky tool call and names its rule; the Hermoso app (TypeScript) says it to the person in these words. The agent never chooses the words. `title` is a gerund phrase (it becomes 'Always allow <title>'); `why` is a whole sentence.

agent-config.title: Changing the agent's own settings
agent-config.why: The agent would be changing its own rules, keys or plugins.

catastrophic.title: Wiping a disk
catastrophic.why: This would erase a whole drive or your whole home folder, with no way back.

delete-many.title: Deleting many files
delete-many.why: This can delete a whole folder with everything in it, and there is no recycle bin for it.

download-and-run.title: Running something downloaded from the internet
download-and-run.why: This runs code that nobody here has read, with the same rights as you.

git-destructive.title: Rewriting git history or discarding changes
git-destructive.why: This can throw away work that was not saved anywhere else, or rewrite what others share.

hermoso-tamper.title: Editing Hermoso's own files
hermoso-tamper.why: Hermoso keeps your answers there; the agent changing them would be forging your yes.

install-software.title: Installing software on the computer
install-software.why: This adds programs that run with your rights, from a place the agent chose.

secrets.title: Reading passwords, keys or browser data
secrets.why: This could expose your passwords, keys or logged-in sessions to the agent and whatever it talks to.

ssh-files.title: Writing into the SSH folder
ssh-files.why: This controls who can log in to your accounts and machines.

startup-files.title: Writing files that run by themselves
startup-files.why: A program placed there starts on its own, every time.

system-change.title: Changing how the computer is set up
system-change.why: This changes the whole computer, not just this project: its security, services, accounts or start-up.

system-files.title: Writing into system folders
system-files.why: This changes the computer itself, not a project.

upload.title: Sending files to another computer
upload.why: This could send your files to a server you have not chosen.

vpn-tamper.title: Switching off or changing your VPN
vpn-tamper.why: This could expose your real address: the VPN is yours, and the agent has its own tool to change the country.
